material_findings.title: Both census implementations capture the outer assignment status, not timeout/pgrep status
material_findings.mechanism: The pipeline runs inside $(...), but rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]} runs after the completed assignment in the parent shell; that parent PIPESTATUS has the assignment's single status, which is the inner pipeline's last command tr, not its first command timeout/pgrep, with no pipefail enabled. [Launcher](../../s4-v6/launcher/s4-r6-launch-v6.sh#L68-L68) [Launcher census](../../s4-v6/launcher/s4-r6-launch-v6.sh#L102-L110) [Driver setup](../../s4-v6/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L45-L45) [Driver census](../../s4-v6/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L108-L114)
material_findings.concrete_counterexample: On the intended clean first control, pgrep returns 1 and tr returns 0 with empty stdout; rc becomes 0 and CENSUS_STATE becomes MEMBERS rather than EMPTY, so the launcher reaches quarantine 5 instead of expected SUCCESS 0, retaining a private holder and stopping the requested proof. [Post-exit path](../../s4-v6/launcher/s4-r6-launch-v6.sh#L302-L330) [First control predicate](../../s4-v6/controls/control-predicates-v6.py#L86-L94) [Expected success](../../s4-v6/controls/control-predicates-v6.py#L141-L146)
material_findings.unknown_counterexample: An actual scan timeout with no output likewise becomes MEMBERS with an empty string rather than UNKNOWN; the driver allows MEMBERS at its state guard and tests the empty string as absence of leftovers before holder recovery, so the claimed independently verified EMPTY recovery precondition is not established. [Driver census](../../s4-v6/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L108-L114) [Recovery gate](../../s4-v6/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L250-L269)
material_findings.discriminator_limit: fault-census-unknown replaces the state after the faulty status capture, so its expected UNKNOWN string cannot distinguish correct raw-status propagation from this defective implementation. [Fault override](../../s4-v6/launcher/s4-r6-launch-v6.sh#L105-L110) [Predicate](../../s4-v6/controls/control-predicates-v6.py#L119-L122)
material_findings.smallest_correction: Capture timeout/pgrep stdout and raw status in the same execution scope before formatting; distinguish 0 members, 1 empty and other unknown in both copies. Reuse the existing private controls on a frozen additive successor; no new framework or exhaustive fault suite is requested.

material_findings.title: Same-command dependent local prevents ordinary holder identity lookup
material_findings.mechanism: holder_identity declares local d=$1 f=$d/QUARANTINE_LEASE_HOLDER in one command; Bash expands $d before local installs d=$1, so it uses an outer d or raises an unbound-variable error under set -u. [Reader](../../s4-v6/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L117-L124) [Nounset](../../s4-v6/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L45-L45)
material_findings.concrete_counterexample: The ordinary top-level holder_alive call at line 248 has no caller-local d: holder_alive declares only id/pid/st/tok, and the preceding session_state's local d is out of scope; holder_identity's command substitution fails and the holder is treated as absent, so an otherwise valid quarantine control stops at 'no LIVE identity-checked holder' before recovery. [Session local](../../s4-v6/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L149-L150) [Holder lookup](../../s4-v6/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L127-L130) [Ordinary call and failure](../../s4-v6/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L247-L266)
material_findings.scope_detail: Calls nested under finish or recover_holder can inherit their caller's local d and appear to work, which does not repair the ordinary top-level path. [Finish](../../s4-v6/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L172-L177) [Recovery](../../s4-v6/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L134-L138)
